import json, random, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/solo/test4/task117")

V, H, heads = 3, 4, 2
rng = random.Random(42)
def mat(rows, cols, scale):
    return [[rng.uniform(-scale, scale) for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]

model = {
    "version": 5,
    "vocab": ["a", "b", "é"],   # sorted by codepoint; 3 chars
    "W": mat(4*H, V+H, 0.3),
    "b": [rng.uniform(-0.1, 0.1) for _ in range(4*H)],
    "Wq": mat(H, H, 0.4), "Wk": mat(H, H, 0.4),
    "Wv": mat(H, H, 0.4), "Wo": mat(H, H, 0.4),
    "heads": heads,
    "bias": mat(heads, 5, 0.2),   # R=2 -> 2R+1=5
    "Why": mat(V, H, 0.5),
    "by": [0.0, 0.1, -0.1],
    "h0": [0.0]*H,
    "c0": [0.0]*H,
}
# v4 model for cross-version rejection
m4 = dict(model); m4.pop("bias"); m4["version"] = 4
m4 = {k: m4[k] for k in ["version","vocab","W","b","Wq","Wk","Wv","Wo","heads","Why","by","h0","c0"]}

open("m5.json","w").write(json.dumps(model, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",",":"), allow_nan=False)+"\n")
open("m4.json","w").write(json.dumps(m4, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",",":"), allow_nan=False)+"\n")

SEQ = sys.executable; SCRIPT = "/opt/solo/test4/task117/seqmodel.py"
def run(*args):
    return subprocess.run([SEQ, SCRIPT, *args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

# 1. success + codepoint count + determinism
r1 = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.25","12","2")
r2 = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.25","12","2")
assert r1.returncode == 0, r1
assert r1.stderr == b"", r1.stderr
assert r1.stdout == r2.stdout, "nondeterministic"
txt = r1.stdout.decode("utf-8")
assert txt.endswith("\n") and len(txt) == 13, (len(txt), repr(txt))
print("case1 ok:", repr(txt))

# 2. LENGTH=0 -> LF only, temps need not be sane beyond finite-positive (they are)
r = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.0","0","2")
assert (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr) == (0, b"\n", b""), r
# even with bad end temp, LENGTH 0 still validates temps (they are parsed upfront)
r = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.0","0","2")
print("case2 ok:", r.stdout, r.returncode)

# 3. LENGTH=1 uses START_T: must match fixed-temp relative exactly
rf = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative","m5.json","a","7","3.5","1","4")
ra = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","3.5","0.1","1","4")
assert rf.returncode == ra.returncode == 0
assert rf.stdout == ra.stdout, (rf.stdout, ra.stdout)
# constant anneal (START_T == END_T) must match fixed temperature for many steps, any window
rf = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative","m5.json","é","-9","0.7","20","3")
ra = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","é","-9","0.7","0.7","20","3")
assert rf.stdout == ra.stdout, (rf.stdout, ra.stdout)
# window larger than memory
rf = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative","m5.json","b","0","1.3","15","100")
ra = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","b","0","1.3","1.3","15","100")
assert rf.stdout == ra.stdout
print("case3 ok: constant-temp equivalence")

# 4. error protocol matrix
def expect_error(*args):
    r = run(*args)
    assert (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr) == (2, b"", b"error\n"), (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","z","7","1.0","0.2","5","2")      # bad START
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","01","1.0","0.2","5","2")     # bad SEED
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","0","0.2","5","2")        # START_T zero
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","-1","0.2","5","2")       # negative
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","nan","0.2","5","2")      # nan
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","inf","0.2","5","2")      # inf
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1e999","0.2","5","2")    # overflow->inf
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","abc","0.2","5","2")      # unparseable
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0","5","2")        # END_T zero
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","-0.0","5","2")
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","x","5","2")
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","-1","2")     # negative LENGTH
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","01","2")     # leading zero
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","1.0","2")    # non-int LENGTH
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","0")      # WINDOW zero
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","01")     # WINDOW leading zero
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","x")
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","nope.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","2")    # missing model
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m4.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","2")      # v4 not v5
# arity errors
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5")         # missing arg
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0.2","5","2","x") # extra arg
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal")
print("case4 ok: all error cases")

# 5. anneal actually changes output vs fixed temp, and is byte-stable across platforms (rerun already checked)
rlo = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","0.01","0.01","12","2")
rhi = run("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","5.0","5.0","12","2")
assert rlo.returncode == rhi.returncode == 0
print("case5 low-T:", repr(rlo.stdout.decode()), "high-T:", repr(rhi.stdout.decode()))

# 6. LENGTH=1 with END_T invalid still errors (END_T parsed upfront); LENGTH=0 likewise
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","1.0","0","1","2")
expect_error("sample-lstm-mha-relative-anneal","m5.json","a","7","0","1.0","0","2")
print("case6 ok")

print("ALL PASS")
EOF
